question: As a new Black concept (win-only Q=W, one net, classic FPU), how does lc0-winonly score vs lc0-standard White compared with lc0-variant Black and lc0-standard Black at the same self-play freeze?
verdict: As Black against the same lc0-standard White (3440 freeze, 120 visits, N=100): lc0-standard 52/100, lc0-winonly 28/100, lc0-variant 29/100.

concept.lc0-winonly: one net; White Q=W-L; Black Q=W; classic FPU negation
concept.lc0-variant: dual nets; DrawScore Q; parent-relative FPU
concept.lc0-standard: one net; Q=W-L both colors; classic FPU negation
